decisions.reason: The authentication service moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and a software service costs little to maintain, so the option is worth keeping open.

The open GIS framework is still only mentioned and has not been promoted further, so its value remains uncertain, but as a platform underlying other offerings it is cheap to keep and holds future upside.
The GIS identity service was upgraded to its own page with more specific integration messaging, which suggests positive results and justifies further investment rather than abandonment.
The consulting workshop launched only in 2024, uncertainty about it has not yet resolved, and it uses existing consultant capacity at low cost, so the option should stay open.
